---
title: "Morning Board"
---

```{python}
# | tags: [setup]
import json
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from IPython.display import HTML, Markdown

DATA = Path("data")
px_all = pd.read_csv(DATA / "prices.csv", parse_dates=["date"])
meta = json.loads((DATA / "meta.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

# Last bar per ticker, plus the bar before it (for the 1-day change) and the
# bar 5 sessions back (for the week change).
px_all = px_all.sort_values(["ticker", "date"])
g = px_all.groupby("ticker")
last = g.tail(1).set_index("ticker")
def nth_back(n: int) -> pd.Series:
    """Close n sessions before the last bar, per ticker (NA if not enough history)."""
    return g["close"].apply(lambda s: s.iloc[-1 - n] if len(s) > n else pd.NA)


prev_close, week_close, month_close = nth_back(1), nth_back(5), nth_back(21)

last["chg_1d"] = (last["close"] / prev_close - 1) * 100
last["chg_1w"] = (last["close"] / week_close - 1) * 100
last["chg_1m"] = (last["close"] / month_close - 1) * 100


def series(ticker: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    return px_all[px_all["ticker"] == ticker]


def signed(x, dp=2, suffix="%"):
    if pd.isna(x):
        return '<span class="stamp">—</span>'
    cls = "up" if x >= 0 else "down"
    return f'<span class="{cls}">{x:+.{dp}f}{suffix}</span>'
```

```{python}
Markdown(f"<p class='stamp'>Last bar **{meta['last_bar']}** · fetched {meta['fetched_at_utc']} · "
         f"{meta['ok']}/{meta['requested']} tickers</p>")
```

## Market

```{python}
STRIP = [("SPY", "S&P 500"), ("QQQ", "Nasdaq 100"), ("^VIX", "VIX"),
         ("^VIX3M", "VIX3M"), ("^TNX", "10Y yield"), ("DX-Y.NYB", "Dollar")]

cards = []
for sym, label in STRIP:
    if sym not in last.index:
        continue
    row = last.loc[sym]
    cards.append(
        f'<div class="stat"><div class="label">{label}</div>'
        f'<div class="value">{row["close"]:,.2f}</div>'
        f'<div class="delta">{signed(row["chg_1d"])}</div></div>'
    )

# Volatility stress: VIX3M/VIX below 1 means front-month fear — worth its own tile.
if {"^VIX", "^VIX3M"} <= set(last.index):
    ratio = last.loc["^VIX3M", "close"] / last.loc["^VIX", "close"]
    state = "stressed" if ratio < 1 else "calm"
    cls = "down" if ratio < 1 else "up"
    cards.append(
        f'<div class="stat"><div class="label">VIX3M / VIX</div>'
        f'<div class="value">{ratio:.2f}</div>'
        f'<div class="delta {cls}">{state}</div></div>'
    )

HTML(f'<div class="stat-strip">{"".join(cards)}</div>')
```

```{python}
spy = series("SPY").tail(130)
fig = go.Figure()
fig.add_trace(go.Candlestick(
    x=spy["date"], open=spy["open"], high=spy["high"], low=spy["low"], close=spy["close"],
    increasing_line_color="#18bc9c", decreasing_line_color="#e74c3c", name="SPY"))
for col, color, width in [("sma10", "#3498db", 1), ("sma20", "#e67e22", 1), ("sma50", "#9b59b6", 1.4)]:
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=spy["date"], y=spy[col], mode="lines", name=col.upper(),
                             line=dict(color=color, width=width)))
fig.update_layout(
    title="SPY — 6 months", height=420, margin=dict(l=40, r=20, t=50, b=30),
    xaxis_rangeslider_visible=False, template="plotly_white",
    legend=dict(orientation="h", y=1.02, yanchor="bottom"),
    xaxis=dict(rangebreaks=[dict(bounds=["sat", "mon"])]))
fig.show()
```

## Watchlist

```{python}
COLS = [
    ("close", "Close", "{:,.2f}"),
    ("chg_1d", "1D", None),
    ("chg_1w", "1W", None),
    ("chg_1m", "1M", None),
    ("rsi", "RSI", "{:.0f}"),
    ("sma50_atr_ext", "ATR ext", "{:+.1f}"),
    ("pct_ema8", "vs 8EMA", None),
    ("adr", "ADR", None),
    ("rel_vol", "Rel vol", "{:.2f}"),
]

wl = last[last["group"] == "watchlist"].sort_values("chg_1d", ascending=False)

head = "".join(f"<th>{label}</th>" for _, label, _ in COLS)
rows = []
for tkr, row in wl.iterrows():
    cells = []
    for col, _, fmt in COLS:
        val = row[col]
        if col == "adr":
            cells.append(f"<td>{val * 100:.1f}%</td>" if pd.notna(val) else "<td>—</td>")
        elif fmt is None:
            cells.append(f"<td>{signed(val)}</td>")
        elif pd.isna(val):
            cells.append("<td>—</td>")
        else:
            cells.append(f"<td>{fmt.format(val)}</td>")
    # Trend flags: above both the 10 and 20 SMA is the simple "in gear" read.
    gear = "▲" if row["close"] > row["sma20"] and row["close"] > row["sma10"] else ""
    rows.append(f"<tr><td>{tkr} <span class='up'>{gear}</span></td>{''.join(cells)}</tr>")

HTML(f"<table class='board'><thead><tr><th>Ticker</th>{head}</tr></thead>"
     f"<tbody>{''.join(rows)}</tbody></table>")
```

::: {.stamp}
ATR ext = distance from the 50-day SMA measured in ATRs. ADR = average daily
range as a % of close. Rel vol = volume vs its own 20-day average.
:::
